Overview

Chernihiv is a city in Chernihiv with a population of 285,000. An ancient city in northern Ukraine with well-preserved medieval architecture and a rich Cossack heritage. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
